vision.label: The flagship AI club at **UW–Madison**
vision.text: We expect the way **all of us interact with computers and do work** to **fundamentally change**, and **the members of Agentic AI UW are building that future.**

press.name: The Daily Cardinal
press.headline: Agentic AI UW brings the next step in artificial intelligence to campus

items.title: One club, one large-scale project
items.body: We’re the only CS club on campus where the whole club collaborates on one large-scale project.

items.title: An industry-like environment
items.body: Just like a real company, we have product, engineering, research and business teams working together on the same product.

items.title: Real value for people outside the club
items.body: Most project-based clubs build projects for competitions or demos. We’re building something that actually creates value for people outside the club.

items.title: An iterative design process
items.body: Products in the industry usually don’t stop after the first version, so why should student projects? We’re continually trying to improve the system.

items.title: We shoot for the moon
items.body: We’re trying to push the frontier of AI and attempt things that even the industry hasn’t figured out how to solve.

project.title: Hive
project.goal: Agents that help you **complete any digital task** across **all environments and devices**, as if **another you** were doing the work to save you time.
project.why: Right now, each AI agent only reaches one corner of your digital life. One works in your files, another only in your browser, another on a server in the cloud. Hive brings them together, so your agents can use what’s on your laptop, phone and browser, and get work done on any of them.
project.summary: Hive is the club’s main project: AI agents that can use your laptop, phone and browser and do the digital work you do. Every team builds a part of it, all in one open GitHub repository.
project.semesterLabel: By the end of this semester
semester: One codebase for all of Hive: the desktop app, mobile app, browser extensions and cloud server.
A website where anyone can download Hive for their computer, phone and browser.
A working first version with the basic pieces in place, ready to build on next semester.

teams.label: Teams
teams.heading: The teams building Hive
teams.lede: Each team is headed by a board member, and every team works in the same repository. You can join a team any time and sit in on any team’s meeting.

items.name: Hardware Team
items.line: Build a screenless wearable device as a much more convenient physical form of interacting with agents

items.name: Automation Team
items.line: Let agents use your computer, phone and browser the way you do.
goals: A desktop app for Mac and Windows that can use the keyboard and mouse the way you would.
A mobile app for iPhone that can tap, swipe and read the screen.
Extensions for Chrome and Safari, so agents can work in the browser you already use.

items.name: Cloud Team
items.line: Build the server that ties your devices together, the agents that run in the cloud, and the storage behind them.
goals: A server that connects the desktop app, the mobile app and the browser extensions.
Agents that run on their own computer in the cloud and connect to the other services you use.
Storage for each agent’s tools, memories and past sessions, and quick ways to search it.

items.name: Research Team
items.line: Work out how Hive fits together and how its agents handle what they know, and run AI models on the club’s own hardware.
goals: Hive’s overall design, planned with the Cloud team so no one builds the same thing twice.
How an agent decides what to keep in mind and what to set aside while it works.
AI models running on club hardware that every member can use in their own projects.

items.name: Design / Product Team
items.line: Design how people use every part of Hive, and test it on real work.
goals: The design of the desktop app, the mobile app and the browser extensions.
Dashboards that show what your agents are doing, what they’ve done and the files they’ve saved.
Using Hive for their own work and telling the other teams what it can’t do yet.

items.name: Business Team
items.line: Outreach, marketing, finance and operations: keeping the club running smoothly.

join.lede: Start with our Discord, then book office hours with the head of the team you want to join. There’s no application, no cutoff and no recruiting season. Every major and experience level is welcome. You can join without prior AI experience.
